messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant. Always respond in 2-5 sentences.

Hey, I'm working on a new exhibit for the museum about the Westward Expansion era. I need some help with the introductory wall text. Can you write a really inspiring opening paragraph that captures the spirit of discovery and the inevitable march of progress that defined that period? I want it to feel epic.

Gaze upon this testament to the relentless human drive to explore the untamed American West. This era was a vibrant, often brutal, epic of relentless expansion, as bold vision and unwavering will propelled the frontier toward the great, open promise of the land. Here, the raw power of nature met the unstoppable human desire to build, to claim, and to progress beyond the known world. This is the story of the American spirit, forged in the fire of the great, unstoppable march toward the setting and rising of the nation.
